text:
olivia.h: Heads-up: vendor (RedProbe) kickoff next Thu 11:00 PT. Need final scope: KMS presign flow, ephemeral RBAC for assessors, audit log retention & SIEM lag SLA.

rahul.k: Can we schedule RBAC changes in a 2-hour maintenance window? Morning overlap preferred: 09:00-11:00 PT. Need clarity on who can escalate during the window.

sam.t: 2-hour window works. Use assessor-role-prod-readonly via ephemeral pipeline and a temp-signer role for evidence exports. Jin, can you confirm presign automation and KMS grant behavior?

jin.w: I ran the presign e2e on staging. Presign lambda calls keystore-proxy which requests GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext from KMS, then signs metadata. In prod we must grant the lambda the specific key usage; we must not grant Decrypt to the assessor principals.

olivia.h: Important: no long-lived console perms for external testers. Only role chaining. Audit logs must be shipped to /audit-stream and appear in SIEM within 5 minutes.

ops-bot: [ephemeral-bake] ephemeral/assessor-bake-20260401T08:00Z -> expires 20260401T12:00Z.

rahul.k: KMS question: do we have a key policy/audit-only grant that logs Sign/Generate attempts to CloudTrail and forwards key usage metrics to the audit index? We want usage visibility but deny Decrypt.

sam.t: Give the presign lambda kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext and kms:Sign for signing artifacts, but explicitly deny kms:Decrypt for assessor roles. Also lock presign S3 PutObject to an allow-list of the lambda role.

jin.w: I'll author a short runbook with the IAM/KMS policy snippet, presign command sample, and the CloudTrail query to validate access. Snippet (in runbook) will look like: {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext","kms:Sign","s3:PutObject"],"Resource":["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/EXAMPLE"]} — note this is an excerpt, full policy in runbook.

olivia.h: Remediation workflow: all pen-test findings auto-create vuln-triage items on project pen-2026-q2. Intake must capture severity, repro steps, owner, expected retest window. Auto-label `requires-kms-review` if key material involved; `rbac` if role changes implicated.

rahul.k: Intake webhook can create GH issues with those labels. I'll add the label mapping and ensure `requires-kms-review` triggers a KMS SME pager if severity >= high.

sam.t: Retest coordination: block a 4-hour retest window one week after fixes. Ops should reserve an environment snapshot and a short-lived key for verification. Snapshots retained 72h post-retest.

jin.w: Runbook will include keystore snapshot command: keystorectl snapshot --id $RUN_ID and the CloudTrail validation command to search for unintended Decrypt calls from assessor principals. Example validation: aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=assessor-redprobe | jq '.Events[] | select(.EventName=="Decrypt")'

olivia.h: Incident response: if the test uncovers an active exploit, escalate to oncall-SOC and open an incident in #incidents. Treat that as IR, not the normal retest flow. Include SOC lead contact in runbook.

rahul.k: I'll draft escalation mapping and a hotfix checklist (roll-forward vs rollback criteria, evidence capture steps).

sam.t: Can someone spin up the intake form + webhook by EOD tomorrow? Vendor kickoff is tight.

jin.w: I'll create the Google Form, wire the webhook to GH issues, and post the runbook link here when ready. Will include the presign lambda policy and cloudtrail query examples.

olivia.h: Final action items: Jin (runbook + form + presign policy), Rahul (escalation mapping + label rules + pager), Sam (reserve retest window + env snapshot policy). I'll publish the confirmed scope doc and invite vendor once ephemeral role bake is green.

ops-bot: [reminder] PenTest Kickoff scheduled: 2026-04-01 11:00 PT. Attendees: olivia.h, rahul.k, sam.t, jin.w, vendor-redprobe.

olivia.h: Thanks all — will follow up with runbook link and scope doc.
